## Created independently: macro test databases

These files were created by the jetdb project using Microsoft Access for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2604 Build 16.0.19929.20090, 64-bit). The `.accdb` was saved in the Access 2007-2016 format (ACE14), and the two `.mdb` files are copies of it saved in the Access 2002-2003 and Access 2000 formats.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| V2010/macroTestV2010.accdb | Named macros, embedded macros on a form, and a data macro on a table |
| V2003/macroTestV2003.mdb | The same macros in the Access 2002-2003 format |
| V2000/macroTestV2000.mdb | The same macros in the Access 2000 format |
| V2010/macroGeneratedTestV2010.accdb | Objects created by VBA with `Application.LoadFromText`: a named macro for each macro action, macros with groups, submacros, and error handling, data macros on two tables, and embedded macros on a form and a report. It also has one-row macros loaded from `Action ="..."` text rows, one for each action name and argument count Access accepts, and data macros on two more tables loaded in scrambled orders. `tblGenLog` records what was created, and `tblGenExport` holds Access's SaveAsText output |
| V2003/macroGeneratedTestV2003.mdb | A copy saved in the Access 2002-2003 format before the one-row macros were added |
| V2000/macroGeneratedTestV2000.mdb | A copy saved in the Access 2000 format before the one-row macros were added |

The `macroGenerated*` files were made with the VBA modules in `macro-generators/`, each imported into the database and run once from the Immediate window, in this order:

1. `macro-generator.bas` (`CreateMacroTestObjects`) in a new, empty `.accdb`. The two `.mdb` files are copies saved at this point.
2. `macro-resave.bas` (`ResaveMacroTestObjects`). Opening the macros in Design view failed with error 2046 for every macro, as `tblGenLog` records; the `old_*` macros come from its second step.
3. `macro-probe.bas` (`ProbeMacroActions`)
4. `macro-datamacro-order.bas` (`ProbeDataMacroOrder`)

## Created independently: BigInt test database

This file was created by the jetdb project using Microsoft Access for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2609 Build 16.0.20430.20092, 64-bit). jetdb reads it as the ACE16 format.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| V2016/bigIntTestV2016.accdb | `BigIntTable`, with a Long column `ID` and a Large Number (BigInt) column `Big` holding 9007199254740993 (2^53 + 1, which a Double cannot hold exactly), -9007199254740993, 0, and NULL |

It was made with the VBA module `bigint-generators/bigint-generator.bas` (`CreateBigIntTestTable`), imported into a new, empty `.accdb` and run once from the Immediate window.

## Created independently: Japanese Access 97 test database

This file was created by the jetdb project with DAO 3.6, which comes with Windows, as Access 2013 and later cannot create Access 97 files.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| V1997/japaneseTestV1997.mdb | An Access 97 (Jet3) database in code page 932: a table `顧客` with columns `ID`, `氏名` (text, described as `顧客の氏名`) and `備考` (memo), an index `氏名索引`, three rows (`山田太郎` / `東京都千代田区`, `ﾃｽﾄ` / `①～髙`, `Smith` / `ASCII only`), and a query `顧客一覧` (`SELECT 氏名 FROM 顧客 WHERE 氏名 LIKE '山*'`) |

It was made with the script `jet3-generators/jet3-japanese-generator.vbs`, run once with the 32-bit Windows Script Host (`C:\Windows\SysWOW64\cscript.exe`), which creates the database with `CreateDatabase` and the Japanese collating order. The script names the file `japaneseJet3.mdb`; it was renamed to follow the names of the other files.

## Created independently: Japanese VBA test databases

These files were created by the jetdb project using Microsoft Access for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2609 Build 16.0.20430.20092, 64-bit), on Windows whose language for non-Unicode programs is Japanese (code page 932).

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| vbaJapaneseV2007.accdb | A standard module `日本語モジュール` and a class module `顧客クラス`, with Japanese comments, identifiers and strings, and characters whose code page 932 mapping differs between converters (`～`, `①`, `髙`, half-width katakana). `tblVbaExpected` holds the source Access shows for each module |
| vbaJapaneseV2003.mdb | A copy saved in the Access 2002-2003 format |
| vbaJapaneseV2000.mdb | A copy saved in the Access 2000 format |

They were made with the VBA module `vba-generators/vba-japanese-generator.bas` (`CreateJapaneseVbaModules`), imported into a new, empty `.accdb` and run once from the Immediate window. The two `.mdb` files are copies saved afterwards. Each also has the empty table `テーブル1` that Access makes in a new database.

## Created independently: form and report of the same name

These files were created by the jetdb project using Microsoft Access for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2609 Build 16.0.20430.20092, 64-bit).

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| V2007/sameNameTestV2007.accdb | A form and a report both named `Shared`, each with a caption, a control and an embedded macro of its own (the form an `OnLoad` macro, the report an `OnOpen` macro). `tblGenLog` records what was created, and `tblGenExport` holds Access's SaveAsText output of the form and the report |
| V2000/sameNameTestV2000.mdb | A copy saved in the Access 2000 format, which keeps the embedded macros in `BlobDelta` |

They were made with the VBA module `form-generators/same-name-generator.bas` (`CreateSameNameFormAndReport`), imported into a new, empty `.accdb` and run once from the Immediate window. The `.mdb` file is a copy saved afterwards. The form and the report have an empty `TypeInfo` stream, as objects made with `CreateForm` and `CreateReport` do.

## Created independently: property IDs of forms and reports

These files were created by the jetdb project using Microsoft Access for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2609 Build 16.0.20430.20092, 64-bit).

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| V2007/propertyIdTestV2007.accdb | A base form and a base report, and 104 copies of them with one property set to a value of their own, named `<Target>_<Property>_<n>`. `tblGenLog` records what was created and the properties Access did not take, and `tblGenExport` holds Access's SaveAsText output of each form and report |
| V2000/propertyIdTestV2000.mdb | A copy saved in the Access 2000 format, whose forms and reports keep their design in another form |

It was made with the VBA module `form-generators/property-id-generator.bas` (`CreatePropertyIdForms`), imported into a new, empty `.accdb` and run once from the Immediate window. Access did not take `DatasheetGridlinesColor12`, the four `WebImagePadding` properties and `Overlaps` from VBA, and `DoCmd.MoveSize` left the position of the design windows as it was.

## Created independently: properties of each control type

These files were created by the jetdb project using Microsoft Access for Microsoft 365 MSO (Version 2609 Build 16.0.20430.20092, 64-bit).

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| V2007/controlPropertyTestV2007.accdb | For each of 16 control types, three forms and three reports named `F_<Type>_<n>` and `R_<Type>_<n>`, each with one control of that type named `ctl`. Every property of the control, of the detail section and of the form or report itself that Access takes is set to a value of its own: a string unique in its object, a number, or a Yes/No turned over in some of the three. `tblGenSet` records each value set, `tblGenLog` what was made and the properties Access did not take, and `tblGenExport` holds Access's SaveAsText output of each form and report |
| V2000/controlPropertyTestV2000.mdb | A copy saved in the Access 2000 format |

They were made with the VBA module `form-generators/control-property-generator.bas` (`CreateControlPropertyForms`), imported into a new, empty `.accdb` and run from the Immediate window until it was done. Access stopped on setting `ConditionalFormat14` of a text box and `OnKeyUp` of a form, which the module then left out of every object, as `tblGenLog` records. The unbound object frame is not among the types, as Access asks for the object to insert when one is made. Saving in the Access 2000 format, Access warned that the values `z1_5`, `z2_5` and `z3_5` set to the subforms and subreports name no form or report.

## Created independently: sample database for the jetdb site

This file was created by the jetdb project using Microsoft Access for Microsoft 365. jetdb reads it as the ACE12 format.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| jetdb-sample.accdb | A small sales application whose command output the jetdb site shows: the tables `tblCustomers`, `tblProducts` and `tblOrders` with descriptions on the tables and columns, two relationships with referential integrity, the saved query `qryMonthlySales` (joins and `GROUP BY`), the standard module `modBilling`, the form `frmOrders` with its own module, and the named macro `mcrOpenOrders` |

It was made with the VBA module `lp-sample-generators/lp-sample-generator.bas` (`CreateLpSample`), imported into a new, empty `.accdb` and run once from the Immediate window. The module creates the sample as a separate file through a second Access instance, so neither the module nor its log is in the sample.

## Contributed

These files were created with Microsoft Access by [@semenenkov](https://github.com/semenenkov) and contributed along with the changes that use them.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| V2007/primaryKeyTestV2007.accdb | Covers `find_primary_key` correctly using the `Index.Primary` property rather than the index's name (user-renamable) or its UNIQUE/REQUIRED flags (an ordinary index can carry either) |
| V2007/columnOrderTestV2007.accdb | Design-time field order vs. creation order: fields ID, A, C created in that order, then B inserted between A and C in Design View (creation order stays ID, A, C, B; Design View / display order becomes ID, A, B, C). Created with Access for Microsoft 365 (Version 2608, 32-bit) in the Access 2007-2016 format (ACE12) |
| V1997/columnOrderTestV1997.mdb | The same field order scenario as `V2007/columnOrderTestV2007.accdb`, for Jet3. Created with Microsoft Access 97 SR-1 |

## Fetched, not stored in this repository

These files are downloaded by `scripts/fetch-testdata.sh` and are listed in `.gitignore`. Tests that use them are guarded by `skip_if_missing!`, so they are skipped until the script has been run. CI runs the script before `cargo test`.

`V1997/nwind.mdb` is kept out of the repository because its licensing is not stated anywhere. The upstream repository has no LICENSE file, and its README says only "Test files for MDB Tools found on the Internet." The file itself is the Northwind sample database that Microsoft distributed with Access 97, in its German localization: it circulates widely and is treated as freely available, but no explicit grant accompanies it. mdbtools keeps its own test data in a separate repository and downloads it at test time for the same reason.

Each entry is pinned to an immutable commit hash and verified against a SHA-256 digest.

| File | Source | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| V1997/nwind.mdb | https://github.com/mdbtools/mdbtestdata `data/nwind.mdb` @ `156fc65` | Jet3 table with only fixed-length columns (`Order Details`), where rows carry no variable-column trailer |

The files under `saveastext/` are published under the MIT License. They are fetched rather than copied so that each stays with its copyright and license notice in its upstream repository (`License.txt` of ruddj/SportsAdmin, `LICENSE` of iKaRus-VLZ/Strings). Each database comes with the text files its project exported from it in the `Application.SaveAsText` format, and tests compare the macro text jetdb writes, and the controls and properties of a form and a report it reads, with those files.

| File | Source | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| saveastext/SportsAdmin/Sports.accdb | https://github.com/ruddj/SportsAdmin `Sports.accdb` @ `a5b9086` | Macros with macro names, conditions, escaped quotes, and macros converted from Access 97 |
| saveastext/SportsAdmin/macros/*.bas | https://github.com/ruddj/SportsAdmin `Source/macros/` @ `a5b9086` | SaveAsText output of the 24 macros of Sports.accdb |
| saveastext/SportsAdmin/forms/Statistical Reports.bas | https://github.com/ruddj/SportsAdmin `Source/forms/` @ `a5b9086` | SaveAsText output of a form of Sports.accdb with 69 controls |
| saveastext/SportsAdmin/reports/Field (High Jump).bas | https://github.com/ruddj/SportsAdmin `Source/reports/` @ `a5b9086` | SaveAsText output of a report of Sports.accdb with 78 controls |
| saveastext/Strings/Strings.mdb | https://github.com/iKaRus-VLZ/Strings `Strings.mdb` @ `9bf2b11` | Macros with Russian comments in a Jet4 `.mdb` |
| saveastext/Strings/macros/*.accmac | https://github.com/iKaRus-VLZ/Strings `Macro/` @ `9bf2b11` | SaveAsText output of the 10 macros of Strings.mdb, in Windows-1251 |
